candidates.note: too short: five months, one season, and it throws away the rest of the only full year the record holds
used: twelve months, every calendar month once, and the series is held out entirely
already contains the first five series months, so the series would help set its own origin
the SDS plate's whole pre-collapse reference: it contains all thirteen series months

input.support_rule: intensity >= 0.30 * peak(support) and >= 5.0 * median(ring), at least 2 cells

metric.definition: z = (median(log x_month) - median(log x_ref)) / scale_ref; R_behaviour = rms over the behaviour block
metric.interval: reference-uncertainty bootstrap only: 2000 circular moving-block draws, block 3, seed 7, reference chips resampled, the month's chips held fixed
metric.reference_choice: the first twelve months of the record, 2016-08 … 2017-07: one full seasonal cycle and earlier than the series; not the SDS plate's whole pre-collapse reference
metric.scale_rule: MAD of the reference, fallback chain MAD -> IQR/1.349 -> SD; the pooled scale of the pre-collapse record replaces it when n_ref < 10 (spec amendment 2026-10-22)
metric.unit: one support-sized chip per acquisition (51 x 137, 861 cells)
